date_text: Thu, Jun 11th • 2:00 PM AEST - Sun, Jun 14th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: We’re stoked to be handing over 12 taps to Bright Brewery for what promises to be an absolutely huge weekend. Expect an impeccable lineup featuring a barley wine, a selection of stouts and imperial releases, plus some of Bright’s outstanding core range beers. It’s a cracking showcase from one of Victoria’s great breweries, and we’re really looking forward to getting these beers into your glasses. Get down, grab a paddle and get tasting. These beers won’t hang around for long. Tap List:- - M.I.A. IPA - Bright Pale Ale - Leaf Peeper Red Rye - Decadence Barleywine - Mountain Juice Hazy - Stubborn Imperial Stout 2025 Export - Kuraidesu Japanese Dark - IBW American Bourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout - Terrano Piu Alto Italian Pilsner - Imperial Hellfire Amber - Stone Gold Fresh Hop - Alpine Lager
